description: This file defines civil time classes and related functions for handling human-scale, Gregorian calendar-based date and time representations, including classes like civil_second, civil_minute, civil_hour, civil_day, civil_month, and civil_year. It provides construction, normalization, comparison, arithmetic, and utility functions for civil times, avoiding daylight-saving time complications.

classes.name: civil_year
classes.description: Represents a year in civil time, aligned to the year boundary.

classes.name: civil_month
classes.description: Represents a month in civil time, aligned to the month boundary.

classes.name: civil_day
classes.description: Represents a day in civil time, aligned to the day boundary.

classes.name: civil_hour
classes.description: Represents an hour in civil time, aligned to the hour boundary.

classes.name: civil_minute
classes.description: Represents a minute in civil time, aligned to the minute boundary.

classes.name: civil_second
classes.description: Represents a second in civil time, aligned to the second boundary.
